name: After § 60
title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_text: 60a. Underlines that a competitive, enterprise-driven economy is essential to sustaining high-quality healthcare and delivering better health outcomes for women; calls for policies that reward medical innovation, attract private investment and support economic growth, while removing unnecessary regulatory burdens that hold back European health businesses, researchers and the development of new treatments for women;
